# `function`

A named, parameterised value that expressions call (05 §12).

## Fields

Besides these, a definition takes the [keys every definition carries](README.md#keys-every-definition-carries).

- `params` (object, name → [parameter](../values.md#parameters); optional): The parameters, in order. The body reads each as `$name`.
- `returns` (string, or `null`; optional): The type of the result. Left out, the result is `any`, which is checked when the function runs.
- `value` ([expression](../values.md#expressions); **required**): The body: an expression or a value source.
- `doc` (string; optional): What the function computes, for the reference.
